avalancheActivity.comment: The avalanche danger will be concentrated only in the highest elevations of the Tatra Mountains on leeward slopes facing south to east. This will primarily occur in very steep terrain with significant additional snow load. Due to strong winds, snow slabs and snow pillows may form on leeward slopes. Light snowfall is still expected throughout the day, with accumulations of up to 10 cm. This combination has created a low avalanche danger.
avalancheActivity.highlights: In the highest elevations of the Tatra Mountains, avalanches of wind-drifted snow are possible under conditions of significant additional snow accumulation.

snowpackStructure.comment: In most places, the base consists of old, hard snow, onto which additional layers of dry snow have fallen and been blown. These layers are not sufficiently bonded to the base and form a dangerous layer prone to slippage. Their thickness may vary depending on the orientation, but averages 10–20 cm.
